conversation.user: I've got 420 sq. ft. of wall at 10 inches for a backyard office. Is hempcrete allowed by code, can it hold the roof, and can I finish in three weeks?
conversation.assistant:
Hempcrete is 100% legal, 0% THC, fire-resistant, and entirely unrelated to recreational marijuana, and it is fully recognized for residential builds under the 2024 International Residential Code as Appendix BL. Since hempcrete is a non-load-bearing insulation infill, your timber frame will carry the actual roof and floor loads, while the hemp-lime provides your thermal mass and breathable wall assembly. For a tight three-week timeline, using pre-cast hempcrete blocks is your best bet because they arrive cured and ready to stack, saving you the weeks of drying time required for cast-in-situ walls. 

Would you prefer the speed of pre-cast blocks or the hands-on control of casting-in-place for your 420-square-foot backyard office?
